method.definition: DCS = conservation * norm_dynamics, RCS = conservation * (1 - norm_dynamics), each rescaled 0 to 10 over the chain
method.dynamics: C-alpha RMSF per residue, each chain superposed on itself
method.conservation: orthologue identity fraction at the aligned position
method.scored_span_source: resolved in every deposited chain of this protein

canonical_against_mixed.chain: sub1, the canonical subunit in both builds

cofactor_contacts_withheld.reason: the cofactor left its site in both runs, which kill_criterion.json records as leaving the pocket arm unscored, so the fluctuation of the residues that coordinate it is measured against a cofactor in an undetermined position

two_copies_in_one_build.what: the two copies of the same chain in one box, as the size of difference a second copy gives with no truncation

isoform_against_full_partner.what: the retained block of the isoform chain against the same residues of a full length partner, each the partner copy of its own dimer

baseline.what: the other copy of the canonical build over the same residues
